name: safesql-mcp-monorepo
description: Monorepo for safesql-mcp: a safe, token-efficient SQL MCP server for SQLite and PostgreSQL.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.demo: node packages/server/dist/cli.js demo examples/shop.db --force && node packages/server/dist/cli.js demo --sql postgres > examples/shop-postgres.sql
